title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.
